  • Constructor Details

    • MoleculeDef

      public MoleculeDef(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation id, MoleculeStructure structure, String formula, List<String> items, List<String> itemTags, List<String> fluids, List<String> fluidTags, List<String> materials, boolean matchContainers, String name, boolean generateItem)
      Constructs a molecule definition with specified properties, generation flags, and inspection metadata.
      Parameters:
      id - resource location identifier
      structure - molecule structure instance
      formula - chemical formula string
      items - associated item selectors list
      itemTags - associated item tags list
      fluids - associated fluid selectors list
      fluidTags - associated fluid tags list
      materials - associated material names list
      matchContainers - true to match container items, false otherwise
      name - optional custom name string
      generateItem - true to generate an item representation, false otherwise

      public MoleculeDef(net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation id, MoleculeStructure structure, String formula, List<String> items, List<String> itemTags, List<String> fluids, List<String> fluidTags, List<String> materials, boolean matchContainers, String name, boolean generateItem, MoleculeInspection inspection)

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
